description.en: GLM Coding Plan (Zhipu) via BigModel OAuth: quota windows, reset-credit query, and 5-hour/weekly quota reset actions.
description.zh: 通过 BigModel OAuth 登录接入 GLM Coding Plan（智谱）：配额窗口、重置额度查询与 5 小时/周额度重置。

description.en: Authorize your Zhipu BigModel account in the browser. Afterwards the browser will fail to open a localhost page — that is expected; copy the full address-bar URL back into the callback box.
description.zh: 在浏览器登录智谱 BigModel 完成授权。登录后浏览器会打开 localhost 页面并显示无法访问——这是正常的，把地址栏完整网址复制回粘贴框即可。
